parties.respondent: The Engineer in Chief Military Engineering Service & Ors.

summary: Arbitration agreement validity; applicability of Amendment Act 2015; Section 26 interpretation; 'in relation to arbitral proceedings' refers to court proceedings, not arbitration initiation; BCCI precedent governs; High Court erred in applying pre-amendment law; Section 11(6A) limited jurisdiction on mere existence of arbitration clause; 'accord and satisfaction' to be decided by arbitrator.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; matter remanded for appointment of arbitrator per Section 11(6A).
